title: Keep a named value
summary: PowerShell: Keep a named value. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: PowerShell variable names start with a dollar sign. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Keep a named value with PowerShell

blocks.text: Open PowerShell 7. Paste one example or save it as lesson.ps1 and run pwsh -NoProfile -File lesson.ps1. No administrator access is needed.
The variable stores 3. Parentheses calculate 5 before it is sent as output.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use parentheses when passing a calculation as one argument.
